SRI.PAVAN DODDATTI, ADV. FOR R3 AND R4)

THIS WP IS FILED UNDER ARTICLES 226 AND 227 OF THE CONSTITUTION OF INDIA PRAYING TO ISSUE A WRIT IN THE NATURE OF CERTIORARI TO QUASH THE AWARD PASSED U/S. 11 OF THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT 1894 IN NO.
KEIADIBI/BHUSWA/DHA/GA-VA/SAAI/---/2021-2022 DATED ----- Sharanappa Gouda S/O Hanumatgouda ... vs The State Of Karnataka on 12 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/64548101/
2 11/2021 VIDE ANNEXURE-A PASSED BY THE 4TH RESPONDENT AND AWARD OF APPROVED BY THE 2ND RESPONDENT IN NO. SII48 ASPIKYU(E) 2019 DATED 30/12/2021 VIDE ANNEXURE-B AND ETC.
 THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR FINAL HEARING, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 -3-  NC: 2024:KHC-D:818  WP No. 100499 of 2023  ORDER The properties bearing Sy. Nos.79/1 II measuring 9 guntas, 79/1 II measuring 1 gunta, 91/2 III measuring 1 gunta 8 anas, 79/2 III measuring 24 guntas, 78/1 measuring 1 acre 11 guntas, 91/2 I measuring 2 acres 6 guntas 8 anas, 91/2 I measuring 39 guntas, 93/1 II measuring 17 guntas, 91/2 II measuring 9 guntas, 78/3 II measuring 23 guntas, 79/1 III measuring 1 acre 5 guntas, 79/1 III measuring 18 guntas and 93/1 I measuring 6 guntas belonging to the petitioners were proposed for acquisition under a notification issued under Section 28 of the Karnataka Industrial Area Development Act for the purpose of laying a railway line between Gadag-Wadi dated 27.04.2017,
which culminated in passing of a final notification under Section 28(4) of the KIAD Act.
The award was approved on 30.12.2020 by determining the compensation under the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.

2. Petitioners' grievance is that though the lands have been acquired after commencement of the Act of 2013, the determination of the compensation under the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act,
1894, is arbitrary and discriminatory.

The issue involved in this petition was examined by the Division NC: 2024:KHC-D:818 Bench of this Court in W.A. No.890/2022 and connected appeals disposed off on 27.09.2023, wherein the following point was raised for consideration:

"(ii) Whether the petitioners are entitled to compensation under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 or under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, in respect of lands acquired pursuant to preoiminary notification issued after 01.01.2014 under Section 28(1) of the Karnataka Industrial Area Development Act, 1966?"
3.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The Division Bench vide order dated 27.09.2023 held that on the principles of parity, the respondents - petitioners therein, as rightly held and declared by the learned Single Judge, are entitled for the compensation under the Act, 2013.

Therefore, in view of the legal principle established by the Division Bench of this Court, the petitioners are entitled for compensation to be Sharanappa Gouda S/O Hanumatgouda ... vs The State Of Karnataka on 12 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/64548101/
3 determined under the Act, 2013.

entities.text: Sharanappa Gouda S/O Hanumatgouda ... vs The State Of Karnataka on 12 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Accordingly, the petition is allowed.

The impugned award dated 30.12.2021 passed by the respondent No.4 and approved by the respondent No.2 at Annexure - B insofar as it NC:
2024:KHC-D:818 relates to the petitioners lands are concerned, is hereby quashed.

5. The respondents are directed to re-determine the compensation in respect of the subject lands under the provisions of the Act, 2013, insofar it relates to the petitioners are concerned, and pay the compensation re-determined after deducting the compensation which has already been paid to the petitioners.
6. The said exercise shall be concluded within a period of four months from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.
